newsitem.title: BRAZIL: No new China soymeal cancellations - Brazil traders.
newsitem.headline: No new China soymeal cancellations - Brazil traders.

text.p: Brazilian traders said China last week cancelled 150,000 tonnes of South American soymeal but they had not heard of any more recent cancellations.
"What I have confirmed is that one client cancelled 150,000 tonnes soymeal," said a soymeal trader. "That was last week."
Eighty percent of that quantity was from Argentina, he said.
A broker said he also knew of the cancellation and confirmed it was mostly Argentine meal.
But traders said they had not heard of any new cancellations.
"I haven't heard of it," said one soybean trader.
Market players last week reported that China has cancelled up to 250,000 tonnes South American soymeal, but until now no one had any confirmation.
